sender.en: A “recruiter”, an online “friend” or a job ad

name.en: Money mule: paid to let money pass through your bank account

how.en: Someone on social media, in a fake job ad or an online friend offers easy money if you let funds be paid into your bank account and send them on. It is laundering the proceeds of crime. Most mule accounts belong to young people, some as young as 14. Even if you didn’t know where the money came from, you can be prosecuted, and your account will be closed.

text.en: Someone offers easy money to use your bank account.
Money arrives and you are told to transfer it on, keeping a cut.
You are told not to tell your bank or family.

Hey 👋 want to make €500 this week with zero effort? You just let a payment land in your Revolut and send it on to my mate, you keep €500. Loads of lads from college are doing it. Keep it between us tho

Being asked to keep it secret.

If money has already gone through your account, tell your bank straight away.
